propositions: The AC1 cross-surface equivalence contract re-calls compose_operation_snapshot identically across CLI, Python, MCP, and reconciler blocks instead of driving the real entry points, making assertions trivially true and unable to catch parity bugs
MCP surface block must invoke the real server via build_server() and call_tool() instead of re-composing, capturing actual snapshot output from the real entry point
Reconciler surface block must invoke the real rebar_reconciler.__main__.main() argv entry point with --dry-run-enumerate instead of re-composing, capturing snapshot emitted at _emit_operation_shadow

Test assertions must fail explicitly when a surface composes no snapshot, rather than passing silently when instrumentation does not fire, using a recorder on the module-global compose_operation_snapshot name

Each surface assertion must anchor to absolute expected content (repo root, envelope version, config key sources) in addition to cross-surface comparison, preventing vacuity where all surfaces move together when the composer is perturbed
Composer perturbations and independent surface neutralizations must cause surface-specific assertion failures in the new test while the pre-change version remains green
